auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy to use. Most common: keystone, noauth.

core_plugin.description: Core plugin for networking (e.g., ml2, linuxbridge, ovs).

service_plugins.description: List of service plugins to enable (e.g., l3, dhcp, metering, firewall).

database_url.description: Database connection URL (e.g., mysql+pymysql://user:pass@host/db). Leave empty to skip section.

rpc_backend.description: Deprecated RPC backend. Prefer message_queues for RabbitMQ.

message_queues.description: List of message queue backends; only RabbitMQ supported in this template.

notification_drivers.description: List of notification drivers (e.g., neutron.notifications.audit, neutron.notifications.log).

metadata_shared_secret.description: Shared secret for metadata proxy authentication. Required if using metadata proxy.

metadata_proxy_socket.description: Unix socket path for metadata proxy communication.

metadata_proxy_workers.description: Number of worker processes for metadata proxy.

quota_items.description: List of quota limits for resources (e.g., network, subnet, port).

limit.description: Maximum allowed count for this resource.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the Neutron API service.

api_bind_host.description: IP address to bind the API service.

api_bind_port.description: Port to bind the API service.

auth_encryption_key.description: Key for encrypting auth tokens (for noauth strategy only).

enable_notifications.description: Enable or disable Neutron event notifications.
